title: Leave jwd-maderas hidden via `except` until it launches, and leave wp-plugins / muse-api with `links: []` because they are private
body: `jwd-maderas` is in content/data/content.*.json with `visibility.except` listing every surface (cv, cv-short, cv-ats, portfolio, linkedin, public-api). That is deliberate (unpublished 2026-09-01, deferred 2026-10-29): it stays hidden until the author finishes and launches it, and its links, outcome and metric come with the launch, not before. Its `problem`/`outcome` still hold `TODO`s; do not fill them or remove the `except` to make the projects section fuller. `wp-plugins` (WooCommerce Seat Map) and `muse-api` (Algolia API/rake) have `links: []` because they are private client code with no public URL; that may stay that way permanently. ProjectList renders a link only when one exists, so no placeholder link or code change is needed. `muse-crm` and `mapas-distritos` have real public links.
not_derivable: An `except` on every surface and empty links arrays look like mistakes or unfinished data; the launch condition and privacy reason are only known to the author.

evidence.summary: jwd-maderas: status in-progress, visibility.except = all six surfaces, outcome TODO; wp-plugins and muse-api: links [].
Renders project links only when present.
